findings.text: Local interrupt delivery through the emulated APIC reports whether an interrupt was accepted for a given vector table entry. Delivery proceeds only when hardware enable is set and the entry is unmasked, using vector mode and trigger attributes from the entry. Performance counter entries for compatible guests become masked after successful acceptance.

Fast delivery of interrupts to the APIC set exposes a boolean outcome with an additional result channel for the caller. The operation delegates to the shared internal fast path used by other delivery routes.

Paravirtual end of interrupt configuration requires four byte alignment of the guest address and establishes a host mapping for the shared page when enabling. An existing mapping is reused when the address matches and the retained length suffices. The supplied control value is stored as current state in all cases.
Guest address cache initialization reflects a given guest address and length against the current memory slot view and reports the outcome of that establishment.
Translation from guest frame number to host address and marking of a guest frame as dirty are offered as small helpers operating through the calling vCPU slot view.
Enlightened APIC register reads fail when a kernel LAPIC is absent and otherwise return the architectural value through the emulated MSR path.

Timer expiry prefers immediate delivery for guests able to receive it and guarantees at most one outstanding deferred indication otherwise. Deadline operation retains expiry information for lateness compensation. Deferred guests are marked for unblock with an additional kick when expiry is observed from timer context.

The emulated timer maintains three persistent modes with distinct arming and clearing behavior. Periodic operation preserves cadence without catch up after delays. Single shot operation arms once and clears its targets upon delivery. Deadline operation arms from an absolute guest timestamp and clears that timestamp upon delivery.

Timer restart clears prior deferred indications before recomputing targets. Software arming is skipped for non periodic modes while deferred work remains and for empty period or unusable deadline inputs.

Expiry lateness handling consumes the stored deadline exactly once, samples guest time against it for observation and tuning, and waits only while guest time precedes the deadline under a bound derived from the configured advance.
Adaptive advance tuning disregards tiny variation and large spikes, adjusts the advance opposite the observed error scaled by guest frequency, and restores a default when an upper bound is exceeded.

Software deadline arming masks local interrupts while sampling time and programming the underlying timer. Software timer startup expects non preemptible context and releases any hypervisor offload before selecting the mode specific path.
Periodic target advancement clamps a target that has fallen behind to the present time, ensuring a single late delivery rather than a burst and avoiding wasted host work and severe lockup risk.

Timer restoration from a non default count register clamps oversized requests to the initial period with a diagnostic and clears the supplied register. Zero period leaves the timer disarmed with a cleared deadline.
A virtual machine wide count of APICs in non maskable mode tracks only transitions of the relevant local entry, incrementing on entry into that mode and decrementing on exit.

Local vector table positions map from register offsets with sixteen byte stride over the architectural timer through error range, with a dedicated position for the machine check entry and an error signal for out of range offsets. The reverse direction uses the dedicated offset for that position and base plus stride otherwise.

Extended APIC destination writes reject reserved bit patterns and discard the busy indication for cross vendor consistency. Delivery uses either a fast attempt that may ask for blocking retry or a slower broadcast path. Persistence of the combined value respects whether the platform exposes split low and high storage, and the write is traced.
Extended destination reads compose a sixty four bit value from split halves or from combined storage according to platform capability.

Partition wide enlightened reads serve identity hypercall time reference timestamp page reset reenlightenment and timestamp emulation controls from virtual machine state, delegate crash and debug ranges to dedicated handlers, and otherwise emit a conditional unimplemented diagnostic with failure. Permission is enforced for non host callers.

Per virtual CPU enlightened reads serve processor index assist page runtime synthetic interrupt timers and frequency derivations from virtual timestamp rate and bus period, with APIC emulation entries satisfied through the kernel LAPIC when present. Unknown entries report failure with conditional logging and permission is enforced for non host callers.

Architectural register reads enforce lane containment bounds and a readability mask, warn on direct extended mode access to the combined destination register, trace the observed value, and support one two and four byte extracts.

The readability mask permanently enables identity version priorities destination spurious interrupt status trigger and request blocks error destination timer thermal performance local and error vectors plus timer configuration and counts, with conditional enable for machine check support and for arbitration destination format and high destination outside extended mode.

Special read handling returns zero for arbitration priority and for current count in deadline mode, computes current count otherwise, refreshes processor priority before returning it, and reports task priority accesses while returning the stored value.
Current count derivation yields zero for zero initial count or zero period and otherwise returns remaining time modulo the period scaled by bus cycle and divisor.
Register presence is represented by a single bit selected by register offset divided by sixteen, with a consecutive run represented by a contiguous run of such bits.
Sixty four bit remainder is provided in two spellings with identical meaning.

Timer state observed across fragments includes a deferred count absolute and expired deadlines a wall clock target a period an early firing allowance a hypervisor offload flag and a high resolution timer object together with divisor and mode state in the enclosing unit.
Paravirtual end of interrupt state includes a retained control value and a guest address cache with address and length used to reach the shared page.
Tracing distinguishes register reads from writes by direction while recording register and value.
Model specific register backed LAPIC reads treat the destination register as sixty four bit in extended mode and otherwise use the four byte register path with zero extension.
